summary: Bohnanza is a fast, chatty trading game where you're constantly begging tablemates to take beans off your hands before you're forced to plant a card you don't want. The fun lives almost entirely in the negotiation - the bean-growing math is simple, but reading the table and cutting good deals is where games are won.
praised: Trading and table talk are the whole game and stay engaging every session
Simple rules that scale well from casual groups to gamers
Strict hand-order rule creates constant tension and forces interesting trades
Great with larger groups (5-7) since more players means more trading chaos
criticised: Weak or quiet groups who don't negotiate make the game fall flat
Can run long with 6-7 players as trading rounds drag
Luck of the draw (which beans you pick up) matters more than some want
Not much game left if you strip out the negotiation

scoring.why: Coins come from efficiently harvesting large single-type bean fields, so the winner is whoever manages field space and trades to avoid planting low-value beans
